name: qkd_kvs_attn_bs2-s2-COMMIT
purpose: SAFE ATTN (KV-ATTN 10-19): safe-control native source 6326ff81a (6040 FF, every non-clock driver <=24 loads, fin <=22) + pin registration (tools/qwen_kv_die/attn_pinreg_1019/pinreg.py: 17 RX zero-test flops retimed onto the existing RX landing flops, 2 ufk fault-root flops split per pin; every input pin -> flop D, every output <- flop (or tie constant), ZERO added edges; lockstep equivalence vs 6326ff81a on all outputs + all 6040 flop nets). Geometry: FALLBACK: the exact 302.4 um slot of ba1/ba4 (drop-in outline, ba4 face groups that gated GRT0 / spread 50.8/47.7); clock S-centre spine. Replaces ba4 805aa57cb (fin_q 1038 / codec 529 / i_ctl 436 loads, legacy reset 256).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && gzip -dc results/arch/kv_attn_safe_control_1019/models.v.gz > {RUN}/models.v && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_kvs_attn_fl u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-PINMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv {RUN}/models.v rtl/qwen_sys/kv_bootage_20261019/qkd_kvs_attn_safe_pr.v rtl/lib/face_land/qkd_kvs_attn_fl_bs.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_kvs_attn_bs2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_kvs_attn_bs2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_kvs_attn_bs2 --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_kvs_attn_fl  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
